MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Graceland feels like a natural next choice because my Simon & Garfunkel listening gives me a specific connection to Paul Simon's music.",
    "The Motown and Elvis collections fit my repeated interest in familiar older songs and greatest-hits albums, especially my mid-'60s and classic rock collections."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Turbulent Indigo and the Cindy Walker collection do not give me the same connection to familiar songs I want to hear right now; being older music alone is not enough.",
    "Greatest Hits, My Way, and The #1's leave me unsure whose music I would be choosing, so I cannot connect them to performers or songs I enjoy.",
    "Christopher Cross and Donna Summer have some appeal, but mellow pop and disco are lower priorities than familiar '60s songs and classic rock today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in greatest-hits albums seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest any collection with a hits-related title, even when I cannot identify the artist.",
    "My interest in older music seems to have been stretched into an equal interest in older albums across different styles."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "A recognizable performer connected to my listening matters more to me than a broadly similar album title.",
    "My repeated choices of classic rock and mid-'60s collections reflect a desire for familiar songs, and I would prioritize those over other music that only partly fits my taste."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in older hits but sometimes missed the familiar songs and specific artist connections that make me choose an album."
}
